summary: Filing is a Form 6-K by Canada Goose Holdings Inc. providing notice of its Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders to be held on August 7, 2026, along with the management information circular and proxy materials. The agenda includes receipt of audited financial statements, election of directors, appointment of auditor, approval of an amendment to the Omnibus Incentive Plan, and other routine business. This is an ordinary shareholder meeting notice, not a special-situation event. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or material corporate action is referenced.
